description: UsageExporter push interface (#45 §3, D-55). All 3 SDKs MUST ship a UsageExporter Protocol/interface/trait, NoopUsageExporter (default, drops summaries), and PeriodicUsageExporter (bundled timer wrapper, default interval_seconds=3600). PeriodicUsageExporter.start() spawns a background task that polls UsageCollector.summary() at the configured interval and calls exporter.export(summary). PeriodicUsageExporter.stop() halts the loop and awaits exporter.shutdown(). stop() MUST be idempotent. See docs/features/observability.md#usageexporter-push-style.

test_cases.scenario: NoopUsageExporter is the default; export() returns without side effects, shutdown() returns without error.

PeriodicUsageExporter.start() polls UsageCollector.summary() every interval_seconds and calls exporter.export(summary). Test simulates 3 ticks at a virtual 100 ms interval and asserts the captured exporter received 3 export() calls with the expected summary payload at each tick.

PeriodicUsageExporter.stop() halts the timer, awaits exporter.shutdown(), and is safe to call multiple times. Any in-flight export() at the moment of stop() MUST complete or be cancelled before shutdown() returns.
